summary: The freshness watcher matches the rulings, but an rclone read failure whose stderr says 'not found' or 'no such' (DNS no-such-host, missing rclone config, Drive 404) is taken as an empty remote. The watcher drops every stream and records a successful refresh, which silences both the overdue alert and the dead-watcher signal. One advisory coverage gap.

findings.summary: lsjson's not-found mapping makes a failed root/scope read look empty: Refresh drops all streams and advances last-success (backend.go:94-98, watcher.go:97-125,150-153)
No test pins refresh-after-prune ordering or :8080 not serving /metrics; both mutations survive
